Rule R_COST [COMMUNITY_RULES]: Current cost = base cost, then every cost modifier in the order it was applied: a set-to-N replaces the running value, reductions and increases change the running value; the floor of 0 is applied once, after all modifiers
Rule R_HIDDEN_ZONE [PROJECT_REVIEWED]: Effects on a hidden zone happen but are not observable to SELF; the IR never fills in the hidden identities

Rule R_PLAYER_AURA [DEFINITION]: uses ALL_MATCHING: while active, every card in the effect's zones that matches applies_to is modified, including cards that enter those zones later; a card that leaves the zones loses it

Rule R_PLAYER_EFFECT [UNKNOWN]: A player-level effect lives on the player, independent of its source, from its start to the end of its duration. With integer uses it applies to the next N matching cards (use_unit CARD) or effects (EFFECT); what one use is stays UNKNOWN
Rule R_PLAY_TARGET [UNVERIFIED]: A CHOSEN target is fixed when the card is played; a spell needs a legal target, a Battlecry without one resolves without it

Rule R_TURN_WINDOW [DEFINITION]: NEXT_TURN of player P covers the first turn of P that starts after the effect is created, from its start to its end; THIS_GAME lasts until the game ends, independent of the source
